unitTitle: Past Simple - A/An/The - Will - Linking Words

exercises.instructionEn: Use the prompts to make questions and answers in the past simple. (continued from page 44)
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib oddiy o'tgan zamonda savol va javoblar tuzing. (44-betdan davomi)
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu — 44-betdagi 8-mashqning DAVOMI (4, 5, 6-bandlar).

QOLIP O'ShA-O'ShA:
  SAVOL (A):  DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l
  JAVOB (B):  ega + O'TGAN fe'l

Har bir dialogda BIR XIL fe'l ikki xil shaklda chiqadi —
shunga e'tibor bering.

items.prompt: 4  A: When (you/have) a party?  B: I (have) a party two days ago.
items.question: When did you have a party?
items.answer: I had a party two days ago.
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'HAVE' (asosiy shakl), javobda 'HAD' (o'tgan shakl).
'did you had' XATO.
'two days ago' — 'ago' gap oxirida.

items.prompt: 5  A: Who (they/invite) for dinner?  B: They (invite) Jason and Marie.
items.question: Who did they invite for dinner?
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'INVITE', javobda 'INVITED'.
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'who' TO'LDIRUVChI ('kimni') →
'did' KERAK.
'for dinner' — 'dinner' oldidan artikl YO'Q.

items.prompt: 6  A: What (he/study) at university?  B: He (study) Maths.
items.question: What did he study at university?
items.whyUz:
Savolda 'STUDY' (asosiy shakl), javobda 'STUDIED' (o'tgan shakl).
'at university' — o'qish ma'nosida artikl YO'Q.
'Maths' — fan nomi, artiklsiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni oddiy o'tgan zamonning to'g'ri shakliga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU MASHQDA UCHALA SHAKL HAM UCHRAYDI:

  TASDIQ  →  fe'lning O'TGAN shakli
              (made, cut, composed, went, ...)

  SO'ROQ  →  DID + ega + ASOSIY shakl
              (Did you go? Did Bill play?)

  INKOR   →  DIDN'T + ASOSIY shakl
              (I didn't find)

QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  • Qavsda '(you/go)' kabi EGA berilgan bo'lsa
    → SO'ROQ shakli
  • Qavsda '(not/find)' kabi 'not' bo'lsa
    → INKOR shakli
  • Faqat fe'l bo'lsa '(make)'
    → TASDIQ shakli

DIQQAT — 'CUT' O'ZGARMAYDI:
  cut → CUT (o'tgan zamonda ham bir xil).
  Shunga o'xshash: put → put, let → let, hit → hit.

DIQQAT — 'WAS BORN':
  'be born' — MAJHUL nisbat.
  I WAS born.  ✓
  I BORN.      ✗ XATO

items.textEn: 1  A: ............ to the party last night? (you/go)   B: No, I was tired.
items.whyUz:
'(you/go)' → SO'ROQ: Did + you + GO.
'went' EMAS — 'did' bor.
Javob 'No, I was tired' savolni tasdiqlaydi.

items.textEn: 2  My mum ............ a cake for us yesterday. (make)
items.whyUz:
make → MADE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Tasdiq gap → o'tgan shakl.
'yesterday' — o'tgan zamon belgisi.

items.textEn: 3  A: ............ football yesterday? (Bill/play)   B: No, he didn't. He was ill.
items.whyUz:
'(Bill/play)' → Did + Bill + PLAY.
Ega olmosh emas, ISM bo'lsa ham qolip bir xil.
'play football' — sport oldidan 'the' YO'Q.

items.textEn: 4  I ............ the grass on Sunday. (cut)
items.whyUz:
cut → CUT — shakli O'ZGARMAYDI.
'cutted' XATO.
'cut the grass' = o't o'rmoq.
Shunga o'xshash: put → put, let → let, hit → hit.

items.textEn: 5  Johann Strauss ............ The Blue Danube. (compose)
items.whyUz:
compose → composed (to'g'ri fe'l).
Shtraus — Coursebook 73-betdagi 15-mashqda ham bor edi.
'The Blue Danube' = 'Ko'k Dunay' valsi.

items.textEn: 6  I ............ for a walk in the park with my friend yesterday. (go)
items.whyUz:
go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'go FOR a walk' = sayr qilmoq — predlog FOR.

items.textEn: 7  She ............ for four years at Oxford University. (study)
items.whyUz:
study → STUDIED ('d' undosh + 'y' → -IED).
'for four years' = to'rt yil davomida.

items.textEn: 8  A: How much meat ............ ? (you/buy)   B: Two kilos.
items.whyUz:
'(you/buy)' → Did + you + BUY ('bought' EMAS).
'How much meat ...?' — 'meat' SANALMAYDIGAN →
'How much' (How many EMAS).

items.textEn: 9  I looked for my watch but I ............ it. (not/find)
items.whyUz:
'(not/find)' → DIDN'T + FIND (asosiy shakl).
'didn't found' XATO.
'look for' = qidirmoq;  'find' = topmoq.
'but' qarama-qarshilikni bog'laydi: qidirdim, lekin topmadim.

items.textEn: 10  Leonardo da Vinci ............ the Mona Lisa. (paint)
items.whyUz:
paint → painted (to'g'ri fe'l).
Coursebook 73-betdagi 14-mashqda ham shu gap bor edi.

items.textEn: 11  I ............ born on 1st December, 1971. (be)
items.whyUz:
'be born' — MAJHUL nisbat: WAS + born.
'I' → WAS.
DIQQAT: 'born' bo'shliqdan keyin allaqachon yozilgan —
faqat 'was' qo'yiladi.

items.textEn: 12  A: ............ the film? (you/enjoy)   B: No, I didn't. It was boring.
items.whyUz:
'(you/enjoy)' → Did + you + ENJOY.
Javob 'No, I didn't' savol shaklini tasdiqlaydi.
'boring' = zerikarli.

items.textEn: 13  Alex ............ the shopping last Saturday. (do)
items.whyUz:
do → DID (noto'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: bu yerda 'did' ASOSIY fe'l (yordamchi emas).
'do the shopping' = xarid qilmoq.

items.textEn: 14  ............ the Louvre when you were in Paris? (you/visit)
items.whyUz:
'(you/visit)' → Did + you + VISIT.
'the Louvre' = Luvr muzeyi (Parij).
'Mona Lisa' shu muzeyda saqlanadi (10-band bilan bog'liq).

items.textEn: 15  Elvis Presley ............ on 16th August, 1977. (die)
items.whyUz:
die → died (to'g'ri fe'l).
Elvis Presli — Coursebook 70 va 72-betlarda ham bor edi.
'ON 16th August, 1977' — aniq sana → ON.

exercises.instructionEn: Complete the text with verbs from the list in the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni ro'yxatdagi fe'llarning oddiy o'tgan zamon shakli bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (12 ta fe'l, 12 ta bo'shliq):
  travel, die, open, be, believe, go, write, graduate,
  begin, leave, continue, teach

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Maria Montessori WAS a famous Italian teacher. She was
  born on 31st August, 1870 in Ancona, Italy.

  She BELIEVED that all children deserved a proper
  education. She GRADUATED from the University of Rome and
  BEGAN to help children who had learning difficulties. In
  1900, she TAUGHT at the University of Rome and CONTINUED
  her studies in Philosophy, Psychology and Education. She
  OPENED her first school in 1907 and WROTE many books. She
  TRAVELLED to different countries over the years and
  opened many more schools. In 1934, she LEFT Italy and
  WENT to The Netherlands.

  She DIED on 6th May, 1952 in The Netherlands.


O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Mariya Montessori mashhur italyan o'qituvchisi edi.
  U 1870-yil 31-avgustda Italiyaning Ankona shahrida
  tug'ilgan.
  U barcha bolalar munosib ta'limga loyiq deb ishonardi.
  Rim universitetini tugatdi va o'qishda qiynalayotgan
  bolalarga yordam berishni boshladi. 1900-yilda Rim
  universitetida dars berdi va falsafa, psixologiya va
  pedagogika bo'yicha o'qishini davom ettirdi. 1907-yilda
  birinchi maktabini ochdi va ko'plab kitoblar yozdi.
  Yillar davomida turli mamlakatlarga sayohat qildi va
  yana ko'p maktablar ochdi. 1934-yilda Italiyani tark
  etdi va Niderlandiyaga ketdi.
  U 1952-yil 6-mayda Niderlandiyada vafot etdi.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR BU MATNDA:
  be    → WAS
  begin → BEGAN
  teach → TAUGHT
  write → WROTE
  leave → LEFT
  go    → WENT

TO'G'RI FE'LLAR:
  believed, graduated, continued, opened, travelled, died

DIQQAT — 'TRAVELLED':
  Britanchada 'L' IKKILANADI: travel → travelled.
  Amerikachada bitta: traveled.

MARIYA MONTESSORI HAQIDA:
  Italyan shifokori va pedagogi. 'Montessori usuli' —
  bolalar o'zi tanlab, o'z sur'atida o'rganadigan
  ta'lim tizimi — butun dunyoda qo'llaniladi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to believe            = ishonmoq
  to deserve            = loyiq bo'lmoq
  proper                = munosib, tegishli
  learning difficulties = o'qishdagi qiyinchiliklar
  Philosophy            = falsafa
  Psychology            = psixologiya
  Education             = pedagogika, ta'lim
  over the years        = yillar davomida
  The Netherlands       = Niderlandiya (THE bilan!)

items.textEn: 1  Maria Montessori ............ a famous Italian teacher.
items.whyUz:
be → WAS (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Kasb aytilyapti → 'to be' kerak.
Ega BIRLIK → was.

items.textEn: 2  She ............ that all children deserved a proper education.
items.whyUz:
believe → believed (to'g'ri fe'l, oxiri 'e' → + D).
'believe THAT ...' = ...deb ishonmoq.
'to deserve' = loyiq bo'lmoq;  'proper' = munosib.

items.textEn: 3  She ............ from the University of Rome ...
items.whyUz:
graduate → graduated (to'g'ri fe'l).
'graduate FROM a university' = universitetni tugatmoq —
'from' SHART.
42-betdagi Use qutisida ham 'graduated' bor edi.

items.textEn: 4  ... and ............ to help children who had learning difficulties.
items.whyUz:
begin → BEGAN (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'begin TO + fe'l' = ...ni boshlamoq.
'learning difficulties' = o'qishdagi qiyinchiliklar.

items.textEn: 5  In 1900, she ............ at the University of Rome ...
items.whyUz:
teach → TAUGHT (noto'g'ri fe'l), o'qilishi /tɔːt/.
'teach AT a university' = universitetda dars bermoq.
DIQQAT: 'teached' XATO.

items.textEn: 6  ... and ............ her studies in Philosophy, Psychology and Education.
items.whyUz:
continue → continued (to'g'ri fe'l, oxiri 'e' → + D).
'continue one's studies' = o'qishni davom ettirmoq.

items.textEn: 7  She ............ her first school in 1907 ...
items.whyUz:
open → opened (to'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: urg'u birinchi bo'g'inda (O-pen) →
'n' IKKILANMAYDI.

items.textEn: 8  ... and ............ many books.
items.whyUz:
write → WROTE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'writed' XATO.

items.textEn: 9  She ............ to different countries over the years ...
items.whyUz:
travel → TRAVELLED (britancha — 'L' IKKILANADI).
Amerikacha: traveled.
'over the years' = yillar davomida.

leave → LEFT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'leave a place' = biror joyni tark etmoq —
DIQQAT: 'leave FROM Italy' XATO, predlog KERAK EMAS.

items.textEn: 11  ... and ............ to The Netherlands.
items.whyUz:
go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'go TO a place' — predlog TO.
DIQQAT: 'THE Netherlands' — mamlakat nomi, lekin
KO'PLIK shaklda bo'lgani uchun THE bilan
(42-betdagi istisno).

items.textEn: 12  She ............ on 6th May, 1952 in The Netherlands.
items.whyUz:
die → died (to'g'ri fe'l).
'ON 6th May' — aniq sana → ON.
'IN The Netherlands' — mamlakat → IN.

exercises.instructionEn: Then, correct the sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  Maria Montessori was a famous Italian actress.
     She WASN'T a famous Italian actress.
     She WAS a famous Italian teacher.

QOLIP (IKKI GAP):
  Ega + INKOR + noto'g'ri ma'lumot.
  Ega + TASDIQ + to'g'ri ma'lumot.

IKKI XIL INKOR SHAKLI:

  'BE' fe'li bilan → WASN'T ('didn't' KERAK EMAS)
     She WASN'T an actress.       ✓
     She DIDN'T BE an actress.    ✗ XATO

  BOSHQA fe'llar bilan → DIDN'T + ASOSIY shakl
     She DIDN'T GRADUATE ...      ✓
     She DIDN'T GRADUATED ...     ✗ XATO

TASDIQ QISMIDA esa O'TGAN shakl:
     She GRADUATED from the University of Rome.

Bir javobda IKKI xil shakl — 74-betdagi 17c-mashq kabi.

items.textEn: 1  Maria Montessori was a famous Italian actress.
items.answer: She wasn't a famous Italian actress. She was a famous Italian teacher.
items.whyUz:
'be' fe'li → WASN'T ('didn't' KERAK EMAS).
Matnda: 'a famous Italian TEACHER'.

items.textEn: 2  She graduated from Oxford University.
items.answer: She didn't graduate from Oxford University. She graduated from the University of Rome.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'She graduated from the UNIVERSITY OF ROME'.
Inkorda 'didn't GRADUATE' (asosiy shakl),
tasdiqda 'GRADUATED' (o'tgan shakl).

items.textEn: 3  She continued her studies in Maths and History.
items.answer: She didn't continue her studies in Maths and History. She continued her studies in Philosophy, Psychology and Education.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'Philosophy, Psychology and Education'.
Inkorda 'didn't CONTINUE', tasdiqda 'CONTINUED'.

items.textEn: 4  She opened her first school in 1952.
items.answer: She didn't open her first school in 1952. She opened it in 1907.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'She opened her first school in 1907'.
1952 — u VAFOT ETGAN yil, maktab ochgan yil emas.
Inkorda 'didn't OPEN', tasdiqda 'OPENED'.

items.textEn: 5  She left Canada in 1870.
items.answer: She didn't leave Canada in 1870. She left Italy in 1934.
items.hintUz: IKKI xato bor: mamlakat ham, yil ham
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'In 1934, she LEFT ITALY'.
1870 — u TUG'ILGAN yil.
Inkorda 'didn't LEAVE' (asosiy shakl),
tasdiqda 'LEFT' (noto'g'ri fe'lning o'tgan shakli).

items.textEn: 6  She went to England.
items.answer: She didn't go to England. She went to The Netherlands.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'went to THE NETHERLANDS'.
Inkorda 'didn't GO' ('went' EMAS),
tasdiqda 'WENT'.
'The Netherlands' — THE bilan yoziladi.

items.textEn: 7  She died in America in 1952.
items.answer: She didn't die in America. She died in The Netherlands.
items.whyUz:
Matnda: 'She died on 6th May, 1952 in THE NETHERLANDS'.
YIL to'g'ri (1952), faqat JOY noto'g'ri.
Inkorda 'didn't DIE' ('died' EMAS), tasdiqda 'DIED'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the present simple, present continuous or past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple, present continuous yoki past simple ga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH ZAMONNI FARQLASH — VAQT SO'ZIGA QARANG:

  PRESENT SIMPLE (oddiy hozirgi zamon)
     Belgilari: every day/night/winter, usually,
                always, often, sometimes, never
     Ma'nosi: TAKRORLANADIGAN harakat, ODAT
     Shakli: fe'l (he/she/it → fe'l + S)

  PRESENT CONTINUOUS (davomli hozirgi zamon)
     Belgilari: now, at the moment, right now,
                Look!, Listen!
     Ma'nosi: AYNI DAMDA sodir bo'layotgan harakat
     Shakli: am/is/are + fe'l-ING

  PAST SIMPLE (oddiy o'tgan zamon)
     Belgilari: yesterday, last night/month/year,
                ... ago, in 1990
     Ma'nosi: O'TMISHDA tugagan harakat
     Shakli: fe'l + ED yoki noto'g'ri shakl

USUL: avval VAQT so'zini toping, so'ng zamonni tanlang.

items.textEn: 1  My sister ............ (wash) the dishes now.
items.whyUz:
'now' → PRESENT CONTINUOUS (ayni damda).
'My sister' BIRLIK → IS + washing.
'wash the dishes' = idish yuvmoq.

items.textEn: 2  I ............ (watch) TV every night.
items.whyUz:
'every night' → PRESENT SIMPLE (takrorlanadigan odat).
'I' → watch (-S YO'Q, faqat he/she/it uchun).
'watch TV' — artiklsiz.

items.textEn: 3  She ............ (go) to the theatre last night.
items.whyUz:
'last night' → PAST SIMPLE (o'tmishda tugagan).
go → WENT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: 2-band bilan solishtiring —
'every night' hozirgi, 'last night' o'tgan.

items.textEn: 4  My parents ............ (buy) a new car last month.
items.whyUz:
'last month' → PAST SIMPLE.
buy → BOUGHT (noto'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: past simple da ega ko'plik bo'lsa ham
fe'l shakli o'zgarmaydi.

items.textEn: 5  It ............ (snow) every winter in Canada.
items.whyUz:
'every winter' → PRESENT SIMPLE (har yili takrorlanadi).
'It' — 3-shaxs BIRLIK → snow + S = SNOWS.
DIQQAT: 2-band bilan solishtiring —
u yerda 'I' edi (-s yo'q), bu yerda 'it' (-s BOR).
Ob-havo haqida ega DOIM 'it'.

wordFormation.introUz: 45-bet — uch zamonni farqlash, noto'g'ri fe'llar, ta'lim lug'ati.

groups.ruleUz: UCH ZAMONNI FARQLASH — vaqt so'zi kalit

groups.explanationUz: Bu ikki mashqda 10 ta noto'g'ri fe'l uchraydi.
Ba'zi fe'llarda predlog SHART, ba'zilarida YO'Q.

patterns.formula: Ega + DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l + noto'g'ri. Ega + O'TGAN fe'l + to'g'ri.
patterns.exampleEn: She didn't graduate from Oxford University. She graduated from the University of Rome.
patterns.exampleUz: U Oksford universitetini tugatmagan. U Rim universitetini tugatgan.
patterns.explanationUz:
Bir javobda IKKI xil shakl:
inkorda ASOSIY, tasdiqda O'TGAN.

patterns.formula: Ega + WASN'T + ... . Ega + WAS + ... .   ('be' fe'li uchun)
patterns.exampleEn: She wasn't a famous Italian actress. She was a famous Italian teacher.
patterns.exampleUz: U mashhur italyan aktrisasi emas edi. U mashhur italyan o'qituvchisi edi.

patterns.exampleEn: My sister is washing the dishes now.
I watch TV every night. It snows every winter in Canada.
patterns.exampleUz: Har kecha televizor ko'raman. Kanadada har qish qor yog'adi.

patterns.exampleEn: She graduated from the University of Rome.

patterns.formula: Ega + LEFT + joy (predlogsiz) AND WENT TO + joy.
patterns.exampleEn: In 1934, she left Italy and went to The Netherlands.
patterns.exampleUz: 1934-yilda u Italiyani tark etdi va Niderlandiyaga ketdi.
